job: Offer example prompts that fill the composer when clicked.
purpose: Text rows under the hero prompt: 15px muted text that turns to ink with a small arrow on hover. They show the range of what can be asked. Clicking one puts its text, or its data-prompt, into the composer and focuses it so it can be edited before sending.
useWhen: The empty state of an agent needs to show what it can do.
A prompt box benefits from three to five real examples.

avoidWhen.when: The next likely reply inside a chat thread; they send themselves.

parts.role: The list; data-target names a composer if it is not in the same hero.

keyboard.does: Fills the composer with the prompt.
